grudge.definitionKo: 억울하고 분한 일을 당해서 마음속에 쌓인 한이나 불만.
grudge.englishDescription: One's deep resentment or discontent that builds up in one's mind from an unfair and vexing event.
The state of blaming or hating someone because one is displeased with something.

grudge.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 사람들 사이에 생기는 거리.
grudge.englishDescription: (disparaging) An awkward or angry feeling created between people.

gutpan.englishDescription: A place where gut, exorcism, is conducted.

halve.englishDescription: To be cut by half; or to cut something by half.

hard-liner.definitionKo: 자기의 의견이나 입장을 절대로 다른 사람과 타협하거나 양보하지 않겠다고 주장하는 사람.
hard-liner.englishDescription: A person refusing to compromise or yield in his/her opinions or stance to another person.

hastefully.definitionKo: 한 가지 일에만 정신을 쏟아 다른 일을 할 마음의 여유가 없이.
hastefully.englishDescription: In the state of not being able to afford to do anything else as one is engrossed in only one thing.

heartily.englishDescription: With all one's heart, great care, etc.

heartily.englishExpression: to one's satisfaction; heartily; to one's heart's content

heartily.definitionKo: 더 먹을 수 없을 정도로 많이 먹어서 배가 부르게.
heartily.englishDescription: In the state of being full because one has eaten so much that it is impossible to eat more.

hi.definitionKo: 친구 또는 아랫사람과 서로 만나거나 헤어질 때 하는 인사말.
hi.englishDescription: A salutation uttered when the speaker meets or parts from his/her friend or junior.

hi.definitionKo: 가까이 있는 다른 사람을 부를 때 쓰는 말.
hi.englishDescription: An exclamation used to call another person who is nearby.

hi.definitionKo: 가까이에 있는, 약간 대우하며 낮추는 사람을 부를 때 쓰는 말.
hi.englishDescription: An exclamation used to address an inferior person who is nearby, in a manner of being slightly honorific.

hircismus.definitionKo: 의학에서, 겨드랑이 등에서 좋지 않은 냄새의 땀이 나는 증상. '땀 악취증'의 전 용어.
hircismus.englishDescription: In medicine, a condition characterized by unpleasant-smelling sweat, particularly in the armpits. The former term for 'bromhidrosis'.

hundred.englishDescription: Of the number that is the product of ten times ten.
The number that is the product of ten times ten.

hwanghae.definitionKo: 한국의 서쪽에 있는 바다. 한반도와 중국에 둘러싸여 있으며 중국 내륙에서 흘러 오는 황토 때문에 바닷물이 누렇다. 밀물과 썰물 때의 수위의 차가 심하여 간석지가 발달해 있다.
hwanghae.englishDescription: Yellow Sea; West Sea: The Sea bordered by Korea and China, located to the west of the Korean Peninsula, and known for its yellow waters due to the sand particles flowing from the inland of China; tidal flats have developed around the area as the difference of the water level at a rising and low tide is considerable.

hyeonmu.definitionKo: 네 방위를 맡은 신 중 하나로 북쪽을 지키는 신령을 상징하는, 거북과 뱀이 뭉친 모습을 한 동물.
hyeonmu.englishDescription: Black Tortoise: One of the four deities in charge of the four cardinal directions, a creature in the form of a combination of a turtle and a snake, symbolizing the god guarding the north.

idealism.definitionKo: 철학에서, 정신, 이성, 이념 등을 본질적인 것으로 보고, 이것으로 물질적인 현상을 밝히려는 이론.
idealism.englishDescription: In philosophy, a theory that regards the mind, reason, and ideas as essential and attempts to explain material phenomena with these.

idealism.definitionKo: 예술에서 대상을 묘사할 때, 관념적 내용에 치중하여 대상을 이상화하는 경향.
idealism.englishDescription: In art, a tendency to idealize an object when describing it due to too much concentration on its conceptual elements.

idealism.definitionKo: 철학에서, 정신, 이성, 이념 등을 본질적인 것으로 보고, 이것으로 물질적인 현상을 밝히려는 이론.
idealism.englishDescription: In philosophy, a theory that regards the mind, reason, and ideas as essential and attempts to explain material phenomena with these.

idealism.definitionKo: 인생의 가치나 의의를 도덕적, 사회적 이상을 실현하는 데에 두는 태도.
idealism.englishDescription: An attitude of looking for the value or meaning of one's life in realizing ethical and social ideals.

impairment.englishDescription: A state in which a certain object has been broken or harmed.
The worsening of the quality of something.

impertinently.definitionKo: 태도가 바르지 않고 건방지게 구는 모양.
impertinently.englishDescription: With an impolite and impudent attitude.

impertinently.definitionKo: 태도가 바르지 않고 조금 건방지게 구는 모양.
impertinently.englishDescription: With an impolite and impudent attitude.

incantation.definitionKo: 불행을 막거나 원하는 일을 이루기 위해 주문을 외거나 신비한 기술을 부리는 일. 또는 그 기술.
incantation.englishDescription: The act of reciting spells or performing a magical act to prevent a misfortune or make wishes come true, or such a magical act.

incline.englishDescription: A plane which is inclined, not flat.
For one side to be lower or crooked in a slanted way.
For a thought or trend to be tilted to one side.

incline.definitionKo: 무엇을 보거나 찾기 위해 고개나 몸을 조금 기울이다.
incline.englishDescription: To tilt slightly one's head or body to see or find something.

incline.definitionKo: 언덕, 길 등이 수평을 이루지 않고 기울어진 곳.
incline.englishDescription: An inclined place that is not horizontal, as in a hill, road, etc.
For one's mind or opinion to lean toward one side.
To be slanted in one direction.

inestimable.definitionKo: 규모나 정도 등이 너무 크거나 많아서 짐작할 수 없다.
inestimable.englishDescription: Impossible to be guessed because its size, extent, etc., is too large.

ireonijeoreoni.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '이러하다느니 저러하다느니' (a conjugated form of '이러하다 저러하다' (be like this and be like that)).

janggu.definitionKo: 가운데가 잘록한 나무통 모양으로, 양쪽 끝의 가죽을 손이나 채로 두드려 소리를 내는, 한국 전통 음악에서 쓰는 악기.
janggu.englishDescription: An hourglass-shaped traditional Korean musical instrument that is played by beating its two heads covered in leather with hands or sticks.

kickback.definitionKo: 개인의 이익을 위해 공적인 책임이 있는 사람에게 건네는 부정한 돈이나 물건.
kickback.englishDescription: Illegal money or things given to a person in charge of public affairs in exchange for having one's personal interest looked after.

kimchitgeori.englishDescription: The ingredients necessary for making kimchi.

leading.englishDescription: The act of guiding by taking the lead.
To guide others by taking the lead.
The act of guiding other people by taking the lead.

leading.definitionKo: 남보다 먼저 어떤 일을 시작해 앞장서 나감.
leading.englishDescription: The act of starting a certain task earlier than others

leading.definitionKo: 노래나 구호 등을 제일 먼저 부르거나 외침.
leading.englishDescription: The act of singing or shouting a song, chant, etc., first.
An act of leading or guiding a number of people.
Playing a central role in a situation or affair.

leading.definitionKo: 중심이 되어 어떤 일을 이끄는 것.
leading.englishDescription: The act of playing a central role in a situation or affair.
The act of playing a central role in an undertaking.
The act of playing a central role in a situation or affair.

leading.definitionKo: 일이나 사람들을 어떤 목적이나 방향으로 가르쳐서 이끌 만한 수준이나 지위.
leading.englishDescription: A level or status that makes one high enough to lead a task or group of people toward a certain purpose or direction.

leading.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어떤 일을 원하는 방향으로 이끌거나 빨리 진행되도록 하는 일.
leading.englishDescription: (figurative) An act of leading a certain incident in the direction one wants, or quickening the progress.

leftovers.definitionKo: 내용물 중에 쓸 만하거나 값어치가 있는 것을 골라낸 나머지.
leftovers.englishDescription: Anything remaining after something useful or worthy has been picked out.

libertine.definitionKo: 술이나 여자, 노름 등에 빠져 방탕한 생활을 일삼는 사람.
libertine.englishDescription: A person who leads a dissipated life, falling into alcohol, women, gambling, etc.

libertine.definitionKo: 술, 여자, 도박 등에 빠져 행실이 좋지 못한 사내.
libertine.englishDescription: A man who behaves badly, indulging in liquor, women, gambling, etc.

materialization.englishDescription: Making one's dream, plan, etc. come true.

materialization.definitionKo: 계획 등이 실제로 행해짐. 또는 그렇게 되게 함.
materialization.englishDescription: A state in which a plan, etc., is carried out; or the act of making this happen.

materialization.definitionKo: 이념이나 사상, 계획 등을 구체적인 모습으로 나타나게 함.
materialization.englishDescription: Making an idea, thought, plan, etc., appear in a concrete form.

maximum.definitionKo: 일정한 조건에서 가장 크거나 많은 한도.
maximum.englishDescription: The most or highest range of something under a certain condition.

maximum.definitionKo: 규모, 정도, 범위 등이 더 이상 커질 수 없을 만큼 큼.
maximum.englishDescription: The largest value or amount in size, intensity, range, etc.

maximum.definitionKo: 위와 아래로 일정한 범위를 이루고 있을 때, 위쪽의 한계.
maximum.englishDescription: When there is a certain range above and below, the upper limit.

maximum.definitionKo: 수나 양, 크기 등이 가장 큼.
maximum.englishDescription: The state of a number, quantity, size, etc., of something being the highest, most, or largest.

maximum.definitionKo: 음식을 먹을 수 있는 분량의 한계.
maximum.englishDescription: The maximum amount of food one can eat.
A number, quantity, etc., of something being the highest or most.

maximum.definitionKo: 일정한 조건에서 가장 크거나 많은 한도.
maximum.englishDescription: The most or highest range of something under a certain condition.

maximum.definitionKo: 어떤 함수가 일정한 범위 안에서 가질 수 있는 값 중 가장 큰 값.
maximum.englishDescription: The biggest value among the values a function can have within a certain range.

medicine.definitionKo: 병이나 상처 등을 고치거나 예방하기 위하여 먹거나 바르거나 주사하는 물질.
medicine.englishDescription: A substance consumed, applied, or injected to treat or prevent a disease or wound, etc.

medicine.definitionKo: 사람의 질병을 치료하고 예방하는 방법이나 이론, 기술 등을 연구하는 학문.
medicine.englishDescription: A science that studies methods, theories, skills, etc., for curing and preventing people's diseases.

medicine.definitionKo: 병이나 상처 등을 낫게 하거나 예방하기 위하여 먹거나 바르거나 주사하는 물질.
medicine.englishDescription: A substance orally administered, applied or injected to treat or prevent an illness, wound, etc.

medicine.definitionKo: 병이나 상처 등을 낫게 하기 위해 쓰는 약.
medicine.englishDescription: A drug used to cure or treat a disease, wound, etc.

megabyte.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit of data quantity.

mid-floor.englishDescription: A floor between an upper floor and a lower floor.

midpoint.definitionKo: 산이나 언덕, 고개, 바위 등의 중간쯤 되는 곳.
midpoint.englishDescription: A place or point around the middle of a mountain, hill, pass, rock, etc.

militarize.definitionKo: 전쟁이나 전투를 하기 위한 장비 등을 갖추게 하다.
militarize.englishDescription: To make another person outfitted with equipment, etc. for a war or battle.

namhae.definitionKo: 한국의 남쪽에 있는 바다. 제주도, 거제도 등 섬이 많고 해조류와 어패류 양식이 활발하다.
namhae.englishDescription: The ocean to the south of Korea; it has many islands such as Jejudo Island and Geojedo Island, and is famous for farming marine algae and shellfish.

nonsense.definitionKo: 엉뚱한 말이나 행동. 또는 그런 말이나 행동을 하는 사람.
nonsense.englishDescription: A nonsensical utterance or act, or a person who talks or acts in such a manner.

nonsense.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 못생기거나 나쁘거나 마음에 들지 않는 것.
nonsense.englishDescription: (figurative) Something or someone that is ugly, bad, and not satisfactory.

nonsense.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 이치에 맞지 않는 헛소리나 쓸데없는 말.
nonsense.englishDescription: (disparaging) Gibberish or irrational remarks which make no sense at all.

nonsense.definitionKo: 무엇이 마음에 들지 않거나 불만스러워서 하는 쓸데없는 말.
nonsense.englishDescription: The act of talking nonsense because you do not like something or you are dissatisfied.
(figurative) An absurd remark that is not reasonable.
Words uttered or actions done unnecessarily without thinking.

nonsense.definitionKo: 실속이 없고 믿을 수 없는 말.
nonsense.englishDescription: Unreliable words uttered without any substance.
Words uttered when one is asleep or drunk.

nonsense.definitionKo: 아픈 사람이 정신을 잃고 중얼거리는 말.
nonsense.englishDescription: Words murmured when a sick person loses his or her senses.

nonstop.definitionKo: 열차나 버스 등이 중간에 다른 곳에 들르지 않고 곧장 감.
nonstop.englishDescription: A state in which a train, bus, etc., makes no stops midway and goes directly to the destination.

nonstop.definitionKo: 도중에 다른 곳에 들르지 않고 바로 감.
nonstop.englishDescription: The act of making no stops midway and going directly to a destination.

novelize.englishDescription: To write an event or content into a novel.

nuclearization.definitionKo: 한 쌍의 부부와 그들의 미혼 자녀만으로 구성된 소규모 가족으로 되는 현상.
nuclearization.englishDescription: A phenomenon in which the size of a family shrinks, consisting of a married couple and their unmarried children.

ogokbap.definitionKo: 다섯 가지 곡식을 섞어 지은 밥.
ogokbap.englishDescription: Rice cooked by mixing five kinds of grain.

outfit.definitionKo: 옷이나 물건 등으로 꾸며서 갖춘 상태.
outfit.englishDescription: One's appearance when dressed with clothes, items, etc.
One's appearance or attire revealed outwardly.

overburdened.englishDescription: Hard to handle as the burden is excessive.

overindulge.definitionKo: 어린아이의 응석이나 투정을 다 받아 주다.
overindulge.englishDescription: To indulge a child and give in to his/her desires or whims.

palsy.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 현기증, 졸도, 경련 등이 나타난 이후 몸에 마비가 오는 병.
palsy.englishDescription: (slang) A disease that causes diziness, fainting, covulsion, etc., followed by paralysis.

panmunjom.definitionKo: 경기도 파주시 진서면 군사 분계선에 걸쳐 있는 마을. 1953년 7월 27일에 휴전 협정이 체결된 곳이며, 비무장 지대 안에 위치한다.
panmunjom.englishDescription: A village that straddles the military demarcation line in Jinseo-myeon, Paju-si, Gyeonggi-do. It is where the armistice agreement was signed on July 27, 1953, and is located within the demilitarized zone.

parachute.definitionKo: 하늘에서 사람이나 물건이 천천히 떨어지게 하는 데 쓰이는, 펼친 우산과 같은 모양의 장치.
parachute.englishDescription: An apparatus shaped like an open umbrella, which helps a person or object fall slowly from the sky.

particularize.definitionKo: 보통과 매우 차이가 나게 다르게 되다. 또는 그렇게 되게 하다.
particularize.englishDescription: To become very different from what is normal, or to change something that way.

per.definitionKo: 앞말이 기준이 되는 대상이나 단위임을 나타내는 조사.
per.englishDescription: A postpositional particle to indicate that the preceding statement is a unit or subject that is the standard for something.

petite.englishDescription: Small and pleasing to the eye.

pff.definitionKo: 실망감이나 분노를 나타낼 때 내는 소리.
pff.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker expresses his/her disappointment or rage.

pff.definitionKo: 예상하지 못한 일로 놀라거나 기분이 불쾌할 때 내는 소리.
pff.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is surprised or unpleased due to something unexpected.

pff.definitionKo: 속이 상하거나 마음에 들지 않을 때 내는 소리.
pff.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker feels bad about or dissatisfied with something.

pff.definitionKo: 마음에 들지 않거나 아니꼽거나 화가 날 때 내는 소리.
pff.englishDescription: A sound made when one does not like or disdains something, or gets angry.

pillow.definitionKo: 잠을 자거나 누울 때 머리를 두는 물건.
pillow.englishDescription: An object on which one's head is rested when asleep or lying.

plump.englishDescription: Having a small and plump body.

plump.definitionKo: 바닥에 무엇이 몹시 요란하게 떨어지거나 부딪칠 때 나는 소리.
plump.englishDescription: A word imitating the noisy sound of something falling onto or colliding with the floor.

plump.definitionKo: 보기 좋을 정도로 살이 통통하게 찐 듯하다.
plump.englishDescription: Looking a little roundish, in a nice way.
Being overweight in a cute and chubby way.

plump.definitionKo: 보기에 좋지 않을 정도로 살이 쪄서 퉁퉁하다.
plump.englishDescription: Gaining weight and looking unattractively fat.

plump.definitionKo: 바닥에 무엇이 자꾸 몹시 요란하게 떨어지거나 부딪칠 때 나는 소리.
plump.englishDescription: A word imitating the noisy sound of something falling onto or colliding with the floor continuously.

polygamy.definitionKo: 한 남편이 여러 아내를 두는 결혼 제도.
polygamy.englishDescription: A marriage system that allows one husband to have more than one wife.

pomposity.englishDescription: An attitude of putting on airs and behaving arrogantly.

popcorn.definitionKo: 과자처럼 먹기 위해 마른 옥수수 알을 튀겨서 부풀게 만든 것.
popcorn.englishDescription: A snack made by dry-heating corn until it bursts open and becomes puffy.

potion.definitionKo: 어떤 병을 치료하는 데 효과가 매우 좋은 약.
potion.englishExpression: magic drug; secret medicine; cure; potion
potion.englishDescription: A medicine highly effective for curing a certain disease.

powerfulness.englishDescription: A nation or influence that is mighty and large.
It's so great it can't be added.
The quality of having a strong power or influence.

ppikkeut.definitionKo: 맞추어 끼워져야 하는 물건이 꼭 맞지 않고 어긋나는 모양.
ppikkeut.englishDescription: A word describing something that is supposed to fit in something else not fitting in the object at hand and being dislocated.

ppikkeut.definitionKo: 손이나 발과 같은 신체의 일부가 비틀려서 뼈마디가 어긋나는 모양.
ppikkeut.englishDescription: A word describing a part of one's body such as a hand or foot twisting, resulting in the dislocation of a bone from its knuckle or joint.

ppikkeut.definitionKo: 일이 어긋나서 제대로 되지 않거나 잘못되는 모양.
ppikkeut.englishDescription: A word describing a project not working out as planned, or going wrong.

preciously.englishDescription: In a manner which conveys that something is precious and valuable.

preface.definitionKo: 책이나 글의 첫 부분에 내용이나 목적 등을 간단하게 적은 글.
preface.englishDescription: A short introduction at the beginning of a book or a written piece, informing the readers of its contents or purpose.

preface.definitionKo: 책이나 글의 첫 부분에 내용이나 목적 등을 간단하게 적은 글.
preface.englishDescription: The front part of a book or piece of writing with a simple description of its content, purpose, etc.

pretence.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 잘못을 해 놓고 자신은 그 일과 관계 없는 것처럼 꾸미는 태도.
pretence.englishDescription: (slang) An attitude of making a mistake and pretending to have nothing to do with it.

prevalently.definitionKo: 유행, 사상, 세력 등이 빠르게 퍼져서 걷잡을 수가 없이.
prevalently.englishDescription: In a state in which a fashion, ideology, force, etc., spreads fast and thus, uncontrollably.

progress.englishDescription: The act of developing or advancing rapidly.
The act of moving forward.
The act of continuously doing something.
To move forward.

trio.definitionKo: 서로 다른 세 개의 악기로 연주하는 음악.
trio.englishDescription: A piece of music performed with three different instruments.

trio.definitionKo: 세 사람이 각 성부를 맡아서 함께 화음을 맞추어 노래를 부르는 것. 또는 그 노래.
trio.englishDescription: An act of singing in harmony by three people each assigned with a different part; or such a song.

trio.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어울려 다니면서 친하게 지내는 세 사람.
trio.englishDescription: (figurative) A group of three people who are on close terms and hang around together.
A group of three people who do something together.

trio.definitionKo: 세 사람이 각 파트를 맡아서 함께 화음을 맞추어 노래를 부르거나 연주하는 것. 또는 그 노래나 연주.
trio.englishDescription: An act of singing or playing musical instruments in harmony by three people each assigned with a different part; or such a song or playing.

trio.definitionKo: 각 파트를 맡아서 함께 화음을 맞추어서 노래를 부르거나 연주하는 세 사람이나 단체.
trio.englishDescription: Three people or a group who take on each part and sing or play a song in harmony together.

trivial.definitionKo: 중요하지 않은 정도로 아주 작거나 적다.
trivial.englishDescription: Too small or little to be considered significant.

trivial.definitionKo: 말하거나 생각할 거리도 못 될 만큼 하찮다.
trivial.englishDescription: Too trivial to be worthy of being talked or thought about.
So small as to be worthless.

trivial.definitionKo: 여러 가지 일이나 물건 또는 생각이 행동 등이 다 작고 소소하다.
trivial.englishDescription: All of several matters, objects, thoughts, actions, etc., being small and insignificant.
Insignificant because it is small and unimportant.

trivial.definitionKo: 중요하거나 특별할 것이 없어 겨우 하찮은 것밖에 안 되다.
trivial.englishDescription: Being merely something trivial, without anything important or special.

trivial.definitionKo: 시시하고 하찮아서 중요하게 여길 만하지 않다.
trivial.englishDescription: Too small and trivial to be regarded as important.

tuition.definitionKo: 수업료 등 학생이 학교에 정기적으로 내는 돈.
tuition.englishDescription: Money to be paid regularly by a student to his/her school including school fee.

tuition.definitionKo: 학생이 학교나 학원 등 교육 기관에 등록할 때 내는 돈.
tuition.englishDescription: The money paid upon the registration of a student at educational institutions such as a school or institute.

tuition.definitionKo: 강의나 강습을 받기 위해 내는 돈.
tuition.englishDescription: The money paid to take a class or course.

tuition.definitionKo: 학교에 다니고 공부를 하는 데에 드는 비용.
tuition.englishDescription: Expenses for attending and studying in a school.

tuition.definitionKo: 학교에 다니고 공부를 하는 데에 드는 비용.
tuition.englishDescription: Expenses for attending and studying in a school.

ugeojitguk.englishDescription: A soup made with the green leaves of cabbage.

unilateral.englishDescription: Leaning toward one party or side.

uniqueness.definitionKo: 한 사물이나 집단 등이 본래부터 지니고 있는 특별한 것.
uniqueness.englishDescription: A distinctive quality that an object or a group has inherently.

uniqueness.definitionKo: 어떤 사물이나 사람, 문화 등이 가지고 있는 특유한 성질.
uniqueness.englishDescription: Properties characteristic of an object, a person, a culture, etc.

uniqueness.definitionKo: 다른 것과 비교하여 특별하게 다른 성질.
uniqueness.englishDescription: The quality of being distinct, when compared with others.
A characteristic of something which is different from that of a general and universal one.

uniqueness.definitionKo: 일정한 사람이나 사물만이 특별히 갖추고 있음.
uniqueness.englishDescription: The state of existing specially in a certain person or object only.

uniqueness.definitionKo: 다른 것과 구별할 수 있도록 하는 그것만의 두드러진 특징.
uniqueness.englishDescription: A noticeable characteristic of something, based on which it can be distinguished from others.
A state of being uncommon in the world.

unyielding.englishDescription: The characteristics or spirit being sound and strong.

unyielding.definitionKo: 태도나 주장 등이 타협하거나 양보하지 않을 정도로 강하다.
unyielding.englishDescription: The attitude or claim of being strong and allowing no negotiation or compromise.

unyielding.definitionKo: 성격이 강하고 사나워 좀처럼 굽히지 않음. 또는 그 성격.
unyielding.englishDescription: The state of not being submissive due to one's strong, fierce personality, or such a personality.
A person's personality or attitude being firm and strong.

unyielding.definitionKo: 타협하지 않고 자신의 입장을 굳게 유지하는.
unyielding.englishDescription: Adhering firmly to one's own stance without compromise.

unyielding.definitionKo: 힘겨운 일에 있는 힘을 다해 세게 덤비는 태도가 있다.
unyielding.englishDescription: Having an attitude of violently challenging something tough with all one's energy.

vagabond.definitionKo: 일정한 직업이 없이 떠돌아다니며 노는 사람.
vagabond.englishDescription: A person who lazes around, wandering without a job.

vagabond.definitionKo: 일정하게 사는 곳이 없이 이리저리 떠돌아다니는 사람.
vagabond.englishDescription: A person who wanders around here and there without a fixed home.

vagabond.definitionKo: 일정하게 자리를 잡고 사는 곳이 없이 이리저리 떠돌아다니는 사람.
vagabond.englishDescription: A person who travels here and there, rather than settling down in an area.

variability.englishDescription: The characteristic of something that changes in a certain condition or situation.

variability.definitionKo: 형태나 성질이 바뀌거나 달라질 수 있음. 또는 형태나 성질을 바꾸거나 달라지게 할 수 있음.
variability.englishDescription: The quality  of being changeable in the form or property, or being able to change the form or property.

vest.englishDescription: A sleeveless garment worn over an upper garment.

vibration.englishDescription: The act of moving back and forth.
The act of moving back and forth rapidly.

vintage.englishDescription: Giving an impression that something is an old thing.

visual.englishDescription: A word that usually refers to a person's appearance.

waterworks.definitionKo: 마시거나 사용할 물을 관을 통해 보내 주는 시설.
waterworks.englishDescription: A facility that distributes water through pipes for certain uses including drinking.

waterworks.definitionKo: 마시거나 사용할 물을 관을 통해 보내 주는 시설.
waterworks.englishDescription: A facility that uses a pipe and sends out water for certain uses including drinking.

waterworks.definitionKo: 마시거나 사용할 물을 관을 통해 보내 주는 시설.
waterworks.englishDescription: A facility that sends out water through pipes for certain uses including drinking.

waterworks.definitionKo: 상수도에서 나오는 물을 받아 쓸 수 있게 만든 시설.
waterworks.englishDescription: A facility for getting and using tap water.

weak.englishDescription: A color or color concentration being pale or low.
Sound being faint and weak.
One's body being unhealthy and lacking strength.
Tender-hearted or weak.
So small and weak as to be insignificant.

weak.definitionKo: 술이나 담배의 맛이 독하지 않고 몹시 싱겁다.
weak.englishDescription: A drink or cigarette being very mild, not strong.
Deficienct or abnormal in one's intelligence.
Thin and weak.
One's body being not strong, but weak.
The content of something being incomplete or unsubstantial.
The reverberation of sound being weak.

weak.definitionKo: 빛, 바람, 연기, 숨 등이 희미하고 약하다.
weak.englishDescription: Light, wind, smoke, breath, etc., being faint and weak.
Having no strength and being weak.
A degree being smaller than the average.
(for volume) Low or weak.
Having small power.
Not healthy.

weak.definitionKo: 각오나 의지 등이 강하지 못하고 여리다.
weak.englishDescription: One’s resolution, will, etc., being weak, not strong.
One’s energy to endure something being not strong.
Not strong and weak.

weak.definitionKo: 몸이 마르고 얼굴이나 피부에 핏기가 전혀 없다.
weak.englishDescription: One's body being thin and one's face being complexionless.
Being weak, lacking power or energy.
Being weak and having a loophole.
One's body being weak due to lack of energy.

weak.definitionKo: 감정이나 정신 상태 등이 부족하거나 약하다.
weak.englishDescription: Lacking or weak in a certain emotion or state of mind.
Lacking energy or desire to do something.

whitewash.englishDescription: To apply whitewash to a wall, etc.

without.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 증상 등이 나타나지 않게.
위와 아래, 왼쪽과 오른쪽, 지위 등이 구별되지 않게.
without.englishDescription: Without a distinction between up and down, left and right, statuses, etc.
In a state in which there are not much of something.

without.definitionKo: 돈이나 재산 등이 넉넉하지 못하여 가난하게.
without.englishDescription: In a poor state due to lack of money, wealth, etc.

without.definitionKo: 사람, 사물, 현상 등이 어떤 곳에 자리나 공간을 차지하고 존재하지 않게.
without.englishDescription: In a state in which a person, object, phenomenon, etc., does not exist or occupy a certain place or space.

without.definitionKo: 어떤 물건을 가지고 있지 않거나 자격이나 능력 등을 갖추지 않은 상태로.
without.englishDescription: In the state of not having a certain object, qualification, ability, etc.

without.definitionKo: 일정한 관계를 가지는 사람이 존재하지 않는 상태로.
without.englishDescription: In a state in which one does not have anyone with whom one has a certain relationship.

without.definitionKo: 어떤 사람에게 아무 일도 생기지 않게.
without.englishDescription: In a state in which nothing happens to someone.
In a state in which a reason, possibility, etc., has not been found.

yearning.definitionKo: 어떤 대상을 몹시 보고 싶어 하는 안타까운 마음.
yearning.englishDescription: A pitiable feeling that one misses someone very deeply.

yeonhaeju.definitionKo: 러시아의 남동쪽 끝에 있는 지방. 두만강을 사이로 북한과 국경을 이루고 있으며 대한제국 시절에 조선 사람들이 많이 망명해서 현재도 우리 동포가 많이 살고 있다.
yeonhaeju.englishDescription: A region in the southeastern corner of Russia. It borders North Korea across the Duman River, and many Koreans fled there during the Korean Empire, and many of our compatriots still live there today.

yikes.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is startled.

yikes.definitionKo: 놀랐을 때 자기도 모르게 지르는 소리.
yikes.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered despite oneself when the speaker is surprised.

yikes.definitionKo: 자신이 놀랐을 때, 또는 남을 놀라게 할 때 크게 지르는 소리.
yikes.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered loudly when the speaker is surprised or surprises someone.
